text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking around the central plaza when I notice Bamboo Memory holding her head.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Actually, I reread the school rules yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I don't mean to brag, but… I memorized all of them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: As chair of the disciplinary committee, it's my duty to memorize them word-for-word! It's just…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I tried to memorize them again—just to be sure! So I read the rules over and over… and after a while, my head started feeling worse and worse…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But there's nothing to worry about. A little headache is nothing for the disciplinary committee ch—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yooowch! Ugh… Gotta… get it together…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's headache persists for some time.
